# Codex Token Bar v0.9.8
## 简体中文
本次更新加入多客户端本地用量统计，并重点修复升级兼容、历史账本保留和图表计价。
- 支持在 Codex、Claude CLI、Claude Desktop 与汇总范围之间切换；其他已支持客户端可按需启用。Claude 仅读取本地记录和已有额度缓存，不向 Anthropic 发起请求。 - 保留 Codex 历史账本，新增客户端及测速数据独立存储。升级前保留备份；归档、删除或移动原始会话文件不会删除已经记录的历史用量。 - 修复选区包含最后一个空时间格时金额突然跳涨的问题，使气泡、固定选区与明细使用同一份模型和用量快照。 - 新增正文 TPS 明细与速度分布；活动速率曲线保留原始采样点。改进模型配色、侧栏设置、多屏拖动吸附和展开收起效果。 - 提供可随时关闭、默认关闭的速蹬排行榜上报；只上报允许的统计字段，不上传对话内容或账号凭据。Claude 来源不参与上报。改善临时失败后的自动重试及 WebSocket 消息兼容。 - 同步修复 Codex 分页子 Agent 继承记录重复计算、Claude Desktop 工具结束后继续估速，以及 Mac 跨夜恢复会话后未及时读取的问题。 - 减少首页重复费用计算和数据库连接开销，增强旧版本升级、中断恢复、锁冲突和未知数据库版本的保护。
额度查询需要本机已安装并登录 Codex；Claude 额度仅在本地有有效缓存时显示。macOS 14 起，Mac 包支持 Apple Silicon；Windows 提供 x64 和 ARM64。Mac 应用为 ad-hoc 签名、未公证；Windows 安装包无商业代码签名。自动更新分别验证 Sparkle 与 Tauri 更新签名。
## English
This update adds local multi-client usage statistics and focuses on upgrade compatibility, historical ledger retention, and chart pricing.
- Switch between Codex, Claude CLI, Claude Desktop, and an aggregate view. Other supported clients can be enabled as needed. Claude reads only local records and existing quota caches; it makes no requests to Anthropic. - Retain the Codex ledger while storing additional clients and speed measurements separately. Preserve upgrade backups and recorded usage when original sessions are archived, deleted, or moved. - Fix the sudden cost increase when a selection includes the final empty chart bucket. Tooltips, pinned selections, and details use the same model and usage snapshot. - Add body-TPS details and speed distributions while retaining raw activity-rate samples. Improve model colors, sidebar settings, multi-monitor dragging and docking, and expansion transitions. - Offer optional leaderboard reporting, disabled by default and switchable at any time. Only permitted statistics are uploaded, never conversations or account credentials. Claude sources are excluded. Improve transient retries and WebSocket message compatibility. - Fix inherited-prefix accounting for paginated Codex subagents, lingering Claude Desktop estimates after tool-ended runs, and missed macOS updates when quiet sessions resume after midnight. - Reduce repeated homepage cost calculations and database connection overhead. Strengthen legacy upgrades, interrupted recovery, lock-contention handling, and unknown-version safeguards.
Codex quota queries require a locally installed, signed-in Codex. Claude quota appears only when a valid local cache is available. Requires macOS 14 or newer; the Mac package is for Apple Silicon. Windows x64 and ARM64 packages are provided. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; Windows installers have no commercial code-signing certificate. Automatic updates verify their respective Sparkle and Tauri update signatures.

# Codex Token Bar v0.9.7
## 简体中文
- 额度和重置卡改由本机 Codex 官方接口查询，复用一个后台子进程，减少反复初始化。额度与卡片共享查询结果，并处理超时、断线重连和退出清理。 - 恢复可关闭的低缓存命中提醒：按实际返回的输入与缓存 token 判断，提示可能由模型、思考强度或上下文变化造成的低命中。 - 续问时限建议、缓存间隔图及其额外扫描仍停用。缓存命中统计、费用账本和已有历史数据保留。 - 保留 v0.9.6 的 Windows 自定义启动入口保护与 RadarBench v6 兼容修复；适配新版 macOS Codex 的内置 CLI 目录。
额度查询需要本机已安装并登录 Codex。macOS 最低 14，当前 Mac 包为 Apple Silicon；Windows 提供 x64 和 ARM64。macOS 为 ad-hoc 签名、未公证，Windows 安装包没有商业代码签名；自动更新使用各自的更新签名验证。
## English
- Query quota and earned reset cards through the local official Codex interface. Reuse one background child process, share the returned snapshot, and handle timeouts, reconnects and owned-process cleanup. - Restore optional low-cache-hit reminders based on reported input and cached tokens, with model, reasoning-effort and context changes explained as possible causes. - Follow-up timing recommendations, cache interval charts and their extra scanner remain disabled. Cache accounting, the cost ledger and existing history are retained. - Keep the Windows custom-launcher protection and RadarBench v6 fixes from v0.9.6, and recognize the current macOS bundled Codex CLI location.
Quota queries require a locally installed and signed-in Codex. macOS 14 or newer is required; the Mac package is for Apple Silicon. Windows x64 and ARM64 packages are included. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; Windows installers do not have a commercial code-signing certificate. Both automatic-update lanes verify their respective update signatures.

## 简体中文
- 修复 Windows 更新或覆盖安装时覆盖自定义快捷方式的问题，保留代理启动器、启动参数和工作目录。 - 修复 Windows 自启动路径修复时丢失已有启动参数的问题。 - macOS 与 Windows 同步兼容众测雷达新版 v6 数据，保留 v5 兼容和评分校验。 - 保留现有用量索引、历史统计与费用账本，无需重新导入。
若旧版更新已经覆盖代理快捷方式，请先恢复原有代理启动入口；本版本会保护后续更新，无法重建未知的旧启动脚本参数。
## English
- Preserve custom Windows shortcuts, proxy launchers, arguments and working directories during updates and reinstalls. - Preserve existing arguments when repairing Windows startup registration. - Support RadarBench v6 on macOS and Windows while retaining v5 compatibility and score validation. - Keep existing usage indexes, historical statistics and cost ledgers without reimporting data.
If an earlier update already replaced a proxy shortcut, restore the original launch entry first. This update protects future updates but cannot reconstruct unknown previous launcher arguments.

# Codex Token Bar v0.9.5
## 简体中文
- 新增正文测速：按本地消息记录的起止时间与正文分词量计算 TPS，区分中间消息和最终文本，展示会话、时间、模型及样本可信度。短时或异常样本可查看，但不计入模型均速。 - 主页展示最近 6 条已识别模型的测速记录，详情面板支持查看历史；额度侧栏展示各模型最近速度，展开面板同时显示最新、15 分钟和 30 分钟速度。 - 更新全会话活动曲线：中断时及时停止，正常结束最多收尾 5 秒。活动曲线是显示估算，与正文 TPS 分开呈现。 - 归档、移动或删除原会话文件后，保留已记录的历史用量；失效会话路径不再阻断其他正常来源的统计。fork 后新增轮次继续统计，重复 UUID 的相同用量副本可逆去重。 - 移除低缓存命中提醒和续问时间建议；缓存命中统计、排行、费用账本及已有历史数据继续保留。 - 更新公共众测雷达展示；macOS 改善额度观测刷新、周期归因、已知模型费用小计和图表交互。
正文 TPS 来自本地可验证的消息时间和 `o200k_base` 分词估算，并非服务端纯推理速度；隐藏思考和工具返回不计入正文测速。网络等待可能影响结果。macOS 为 ad-hoc 签名，未经过 Apple 公证；请从官方发布页下载安装包。Windows 自动更新失败时，可使用官方安装器安装到原目录并保留历史数据。
## English
- Adds body-text TPS from local message start/end times and tokenized text, separating intermediate messages from final text. Samples show the conversation, time, model and confidence. Short or anomalous samples remain inspectable but are excluded from model averages. - Shows the six latest model-identified samples on the dashboard, with history in a details panel. The quota sidebar shows recent model speeds; its expanded panel includes latest, 15-minute and 30-minute speeds. - Updates the all-session activity curve: interruptions stop it promptly, and normal completion finishes within five seconds. This display estimate is shown separately from body-text TPS. - Preserves recorded usage after session files are archived, moved or deleted. Missing rollout references no longer block other valid sources. Fork-owned new rounds remain counted, and identical usage copies within one UUID are reversibly deduplicated. - Removes low-cache-hit reminders and follow-up timing recommendations while retaining cache-hit statistics, rankings, the cost ledger and existing history. - Updates public benchmark presentation. macOS also improves quota refresh, cycle attribution, known-price subtotals and chart interaction.
Body-text TPS uses verifiable local message timing and estimated `o200k_base` token counts; it is not pure server-generation throughput. Hidden reasoning and tool-return text are excluded. Network waits can affect results. The macOS build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized; download installers from the official release page. If Windows automatic updating fails, use the official installer in the original directory and retain local history.

# Codex Token Bar v0.9.4
## 简体中文
- 修复压缩聊天历史的读取与索引，普通 JSONL 和 JSONL.zst 共用来源身份，切换存储格式或同时存在两种文件时避免重复计数。 - 升级历史索引时保留已有消费记录和扫描断点；读取失败时保留可信历史数据，并提供有界扫描诊断。 - 减少排行摘录和消息链接补全对冷压缩历史的重复读取，必要的统计仍会验证正文。 - 加固 Windows 更新状态、安装器启动错误处理、安装路径和快捷方式检查，以及新进程对升级结果的确认。
Windows 旧版更新器的行为由旧版程序决定。如自动更新失败，请使用本版本的官方安装器安装到原目录，并核对启动后的版本。请保留本地历史数据。
## English
- Fixes compressed history reading and indexing. Plain JSONL and JSONL.zst share source identity to avoid duplicate counts when storage formats change or both representations exist. - Preserves recorded usage and scan checkpoints during index upgrades, retaining trusted history and bounded diagnostics when reading fails. - Reduces repeated reads of cold compressed history for ranking excerpts and message links while still validating content required for statistics. - Hardens Windows update state, installer launch failure handling, installation paths, shortcuts, and upgrade confirmation by the new process.
The old Windows executable controls its own updater behavior. If automatic updating fails, use this version's official installer in the original directory and check the version after launch. Keep local history data.
